gloss: recovery; undoing (mostly in {取|と}り{返|かえ}しがつかない)

definitions.gloss: recovery; undoing (mostly in {取|と}り{返|かえ}しがつかない)
definitions.explanation: Getting back what was lost or putting right what was done; nearly always in the negative {取|と}り{返|かえ}しがつかない, 'irreversible, beyond repair'.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧なら⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{取|と}り{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく。
examples.english: It can still be put right now.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{返|かえ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つかないこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I've done something that can't be undone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{放|ほう}っておく→放っておく：18382_houtteoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{取|と}り{返|かえ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つかない⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧かねない。
examples.english: Even a small mistake, if left alone, can lead to an irreversible situation.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {取|と}り{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない: irreversible, beyond repair
- {取|と}り{返|かえ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つかない + noun: an irreparable (mistake, loss)
- {取|と}り{返|かえ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つく: can still be put right (mostly in contrast with the negative)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{返|かえ}す→取り返す：06050_torikaesu⟧: to get back, to recover (the verb)
- ⟦{後悔|こうかい}{先|さき}に{立|た}たず→後悔先に立たず：31626_koukaisakinitatazu⟧: regret always comes too late
